hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in */src/components/*|*/src/styles/global.css|*/src/styles/typography.css|*/src/constants.ts|*/astro.config.ts) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"A design-surface file was just edited. Per CLAUDE.md, if this changed a design-architecture decision (color tokens, typeface roles, theming mechanism, naming conventions, guardrails, or component structure), update docs/design.md: the relevant section plus a dated Change log entry. If it was only a value/bugfix change, no docs/design.md update is needed."}}';; esac
